author: agent
sentences: Our habit tracker app launched last month.
It passed 25,000 downloads in the first week.
Here are the five steps we followed.
First, we wrote the store page before the code.
Second, we invited friends to a private beta.
Third, we fixed every crash they reported.
Fourth, we picked a launch day and told our mailing list.
Fifth, we answered every review in the first week.
